regions.region: page 1 center-left generic reaction scheme (1 + 2 -> E-3)
regions.finding: Generic reaction-class scheme with 10 mol% Pd(PPh3)4, 100 mol% HOAc, THF, r.t.; classified as a general scheme, not an individual reported experiment.
1H-1H NOESY depiction for E-3aa; supports the reported E alkene-configuration assignment and is associated with the standard 1a/2a experiment.
Background and cited prior palladium/rhodium/nickel literature; no cited prior-work item was converted into a reported experiment of this paper.

regions.region: page 1 right-column prose discussing solvent and catalyst screening
regions.finding: Narrative overview cross-references Tables 1-3 on page 2; row-level experiments are recorded from the tables, while this prose supplies context and no additional independent row.

unresolved: Generic R1/R2/R3 structures are not fully specified and therefore have null SMILES.
Figure 1 establishes an E assignment but does not independently provide full experimental conditions.

regions.region: page 2 upper-left Table 1 including scheme, nine solvent rows, and footnotes
regions.finding: Nine solvent-screen experiments were read row by row, including four NR rows with recovered 1a, a trace result, the 75%/85:0:15 MeOH result, and the standard THF row. Table 1 entry 9 is merged with the same standard experiment repeated elsewhere.

regions.region: page 2 lower-left Table 2 including scheme, six catalyst rows, and footnotes
regions.finding: Six catalyst-screen experiments were recorded separately. Footnote c's added 20 mol% PPh3 was structured as a participant for entries 3-6; NR/recovered starting material and trace outcomes were preserved.

regions.region: page 2 upper-right Table 3 including scheme, eight loading/temperature rows, and footnotes
regions.finding: Eight catalyst-loading/temperature experiments were read row by row. Entry 4 is the repeated 10 mol%, r.t., 24 h, 81% standard experiment and was merged rather than duplicated; the other seven rows remain independent.

regions.region: page 2 middle-right Table 4 including scheme, four HOAc rows, and footnotes
regions.finding: Four HOAc-loading experiments were read row by row. Entry 3 is the repeated standard experiment and was merged; entries 1, 2, and 4 remain separate records.
Defines conditions A as 10 mol% Pd(PPh3)4, 100 mol% HOAc, THF, r.t. and introduces Table 5; this context is applied only where explicitly referenced.

unresolved: Selectivity >=97% is an author assumption from 300 MHz 1H NMR non-observation, not an exact measured percentage.
Product structures are retained as labels unless a source-linked candidate SMILES was safely expressible; none is structure-verified.

regions.region: page 3 upper-left Table 5 scheme, twelve substrate-scope rows, and footnote
regions.finding: All twelve scope rows were recorded separately with substrate labels, conditions A, time, isolated yield, and reported absence of Z-3. Entry 6 also retains the footnoted unidentified product as a separate unresolved product participant.

regions.region: page 3 upper-right Experimental Section, Typical Procedure I
regions.finding: Preparation of allene 1a was extracted as a multistep reported experiment with reactant/reagent/solvent amounts, -78 °C addition, reflux, workup/purification, product mass, and 68% isolated yield.

regions.region: page 3 center-right Experimental Section, Typical Procedure II
regions.finding: Detailed standard 1a + 2a experiment was linked to the repeated standard table rows, including masses/amounts, nitrogen atmosphere, THF, TLC monitoring, chromatography, 63 mg product, and 81% isolated yield.
Author-proposed oxidative-addition/hydrometalation/Suzuki-type coupling sequence was classified as a mechanism record, not a reported mechanistic experiment.

regions.region: page 3 lower-right Supporting Information Available statement
regions.finding: The article states that SI exists, but no SI file was explicitly provided or associated in this workspace; association remains unestablished.

unresolved: Typical Procedure II prints AcOH as 14 uL, 0.25 mol, which conflicts with both physical plausibility and the table's 100 mol%; the source value was preserved without silently changing mol to mmol.
Table 5 does not provide row-specific substrate amounts, solvent volume, atmosphere, or workup.
Table 5 entry 6's additional product is unidentified and unquantified.
The exact connectivity/stereochemical SMILES for the drawn 2h substituent remains unresolved.
SI is mentioned but was not explicitly supplied or associated.
